title: Linear regression with probabilistic networks for network-linked data
abstract: arXiv:2610.18937v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Network-linked data combine a network with covariates and responses observed for its nodes. Common regression approaches either model dependence among neighboring responses using the observed network or capture similarities associated with network structure without explicitly modeling response dependence. We propose a probabilistic network-linked data analysis framework that incorporates both features while accounting for randomness in network formation. The model uses normalized connection probabilities to weight peer responses and latent positions to capture network cohesion. A two-step likelihood procedure first estimates the network structure and then fits the response model. We establish theoretical guarantees for network recovery in sparse networks with heterogeneous node effects, and prove consistency and joint asymptotic normality of the regression estimators subject to suitable conditions. translated_title: 基于概率网络的网络关联数据线性回归
translated_abstract: 网络关联数据将网络结构与其节点上观测到的协变量和响应变量相结合。常见的回归方法要么利用观测到的网络对相邻响应之间的依赖关系进行建模，要么捕捉与网络结构相关的相似性而不显式地对响应依赖性建模。我们提出了一个概率性的网络关联数据分析框架，该框架同时融合了这两种特性，并考虑了网络形成过程中的随机性。该模型使用归一化的连接概率对同伴响应进行加权，并利用潜在位置来捕捉网络凝聚性。我们提出了一种两步似然方法：首先估计网络结构，然后拟合响应模型。我们为具有异质节点效应的稀疏网络中的网络恢复建立了理论保证，并在适当条件下证明了回归估计量的一致性与联合渐近正态性。该分析还阐明了估计在何种情况下……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个同时建模响应依赖性与网络凝聚性、并考虑网络形成随机性的概率网络回归框架，通过两步似然方法先估计网络结构再拟合响应模型，并为稀疏网络下的网络恢复、估计量一致性和渐近正态性提供了理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a probabilistic regression framework for network-linked data that jointly models response dependence and network cohesion while accounting for random network formation, using a two-step likelihood procedure with theoretical guarantees for network recovery, consistency, and asymptotic normality of the estimators.
